name: SCAS Agronomic Rule Set v1
status: SOURCE-TRACEABLE STARTER — production expansion requires crop/state/zone-specific validation
design_principles: XGBoost proposes; the agronomic rule engine validates and reranks.
A rule may hard-reject only when an authoritative source supports the constraint and the relevant context is known.
Unknown or missing agronomic evidence must not be treated as a violation.
Rules are context-aware: crop + state/zone + season + irrigation + soil + climate.
Fertilizer doses are not generated by these rules; the fertilizer engine uses the separate Requirement 2 knowledge base.
Every rule carries source, scope, evidence type, and confidence.

soil_health_card_nutrient_classes.source: Government of India Soil Health Card Soil Sampling & Testing Manual
soil_health_card_nutrient_classes.implementation_note: These are national Soil Health Card teaching/reference classes. They are useful for deficiency/condition classification but must not be substituted for crop- and zone-specific critical limits where an STCR or state recommendation exists.

rules.region: Karnataka Eastern Dry Zone / Zone V
rules.source: University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru — ARS Chintamani
rules.scope: Karnataka Eastern Dry Zone; regional crop research context
rules.explanation: UAS Bengaluru identifies ARS Chintamani as a Zone V location and conducts location-specific dryland research on these crops.

rules.source: University of Agricultural Sciences, Bengaluru — Soil Test Crop Response
rules.explanation: UAS Bengaluru reports development of STCR targeted-yield fertilizer prescription equations for Karnataka zones 3–7. These should be queried by the fertilizer engine when a matching crop/zone equation is available.
ICAR identifies nitrogen, phosphorus and zinc deficiency as important soil constraints in Karnataka red and black soils.

rules.source: UAS Bengaluru Soil Test Crop Response; Government of India Soil Health Card guidance
rules.explanation: STCR is specifically designed to calibrate fertilizer recommendations from soil-test values and targeted yield; use it when the matching crop/zone/yield equation exists.

rules.source: Government of India Soil Health Card guidance and ICAR balanced nutrient-management advisories
rules.explanation: Government guidance describes field-specific, crop-wise fertilizer recommendations based on soil nutrient status; ICAR advisories emphasize soil-test-based balanced nutrient management.

unknown_rule_policy.explanation_to_user: Agronomic validation is limited for this crop/region combination; recommendation is based primarily on the trained model and available evidence.
unknown_rule_policy.production_requirement: Add a reviewed crop × region × season rule before treating the rule engine as fully validated for that combination.

rule_scoring.recommended_logic: score = model_score + regional_bonus + agronomic_positive_bonus - agronomic_warning_penalty - unknown_rule_penalty
rule_scoring.hard_reject_policy: Only for authoritative, explicitly validated constraints. Do not hard-reject solely because a source gives a preferred range.
